results.title: Gender Minister engages Obuasi SHTS students affected by allegations, assures them of support
results.content: The Minister for Gender, Children and Social Protection, Dr Agnes Naa Momo Lartey, has engaged students affected by the alleged sexual abuse at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), assuring them of the government’s support as investigations into the matter continue.

results.title: GAF says it’s ready to confront any security threat against Ghana
results.content: The Ghana Armed Forces (GAF) says it is prepared to confront any threat to the country’s security and defend its territorial integrity against external aggression.

results.title: Techiman North moves to end post-harvest losses with new storage facilities and irrigation plans
results.content: In a significant move to bolster the local agricultural sector, the Techiman North District Assembly has announced ambitious plans to establish modern storage facilities and develop irrigation systems.

results.title: Health Ministry calls for stronger measures to tackle lead poisoning
results.content: The Ministry of Health has called for stronger regulation, public education and collaboration among key institutions to prevent lead poisoning and protect children from its harmful effects.

results.title: Gender Minister engages Obuasi SHTS authorities, community leaders over alleged sexual abuse
results.content: The Minister for Gender, Children and Social Protection, Dr Agnes Naa Momo Lartey, has engaged authorities of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) and community leaders on measures to protect students and support those affected by allegations of sexual abuse at the school.

results.title: There’s no ‘dumsor’ in Ghana; there’s adequate power -Mahama tells Ghanaians in Russia
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama says Ghana is no longer experiencing power outages, popularly known as dumsor, following efforts by his government to resolve the financial challenges that threatened electricity supply.

results.title: ‘The players are very motivated’ – GoldStars SC boss confident ahead of Samartex clash
results.content: The Miners secured a 2-1 win over Heart of Lions on matchweek eight and are occupying the 12th position in the league standings with 10 points from eight matches.

results.title: Police arrest man over alleged fatal shooting of wife in Northern Region
results.content: Police in Bimbilla have arrested a 35-year-old man for allegedly shooting his wife dead following a domestic dispute at Fulakuma, a community near Chamba in the Nanumba North Municipality.

results.title: Nearly 2 million young Ghanaians not in employment, education or training – GSS
results.content: Nearly two million Ghanaians aged between 15 and 35 were neither employed nor enrolled in education or training in the third quarter of 2025, according to the Ghana Statistical Service (GSS).

results.title: World Vision Ghana calls for increased, sustained investment in hygiene infrastructure
results.content: World Vision Ghana has called for increased and sustained investment in hygiene infrastructure, saying that awareness creation alone was insufficient to improve hand hygiene practices and protect public health.

results.title: Vivo Energy leads pack with quadruple win at National PR and Communications Excellence Awards
results.content: Commenting on the awards, the Corporate Communications Manager of Vivo Energy Ghana, Shirley Tony Kum said the recognition of Vivo Energy Ghana as PR Organisation of the Year in both the Commercial and Energy and Utilities categories further reinforces the company’s position as a leading player in Ghana’s downstream petroleum industry.

results.title: Breast cancer survivor urges women to seek early treatment, reject stigma, and keep hope alive
results.content: A Breast cancer survivor, Jemima, has urged women to seek medical attention at the first sign of changes in their breasts, warning that delaying treatment could cost them their lives.

results.title: About 22 laws introduced to lock in reforms and protect Ghana’s economic gains – Ato Forson
results.content: Finance Minister Dr. Cassiel Ato Forson says the government has introduced about 22 laws over the past 18 months to make its reforms last and protect the economic stability Ghanaians have sacrificed to achieve. He said the aim is to prevent future governments from reversing the progress made and taking the country back to the […]

results.title: KATH records 4 to 6 new stroke cases daily, over 1,000 annually – Neurologist reveals disturbing trend among youth
results.content: The Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital (KATH) has raised alarm over a sharp increase in stroke cases reported to the facility, describing the trend as a major public health concern.

results.title: JoyNews gets results: Mahama intervenes, four arrested as Abesua galamsey-damaged bridge undergoes repairs
results.content: Four people have been arrested and are in police custody following JoyNews’ exclusive report on the destruction of the only access bridge linking several communities in the Abesua Electoral Area of the Atwima Mponua District in the Ashanti Region.

results.title: NAIMOS intensifies operations against illegal mining in Western and Eastern Regions
results.content: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) has intensified enforcement operations against illegal mining in the Western and Eastern Regions, targeting activities in forest reserves, farming areas and along critical water bodies.

results.title: Torgbiga Addo IX sworn in as Paramount Chief of Klikor Traditional Area
results.content: The chiefs, elders and people of the Klikor Traditional Area have formally installed and sworn in Torgbiga Addo IX, Dr Frank Hukporti, as their Paramount Chief. results.title: GPL: Heart of Lions coach Kasim Gokyildiz steps down from role
results.content: Gokyildiz signed a one-year contract with the Lions, with the possibility of renewal after Bashir Hayford parted ways with the team when his contract expired.

results.title: My son didn’t deserve to die; he complained of bullying in school — Father of Ghanaian teenager shot in New York
results.content: The father of a 15-year-old Ghanaian boy who was shot dead in the Bronx, New York, has expressed grief over his son's death, insisting that the teenager was innocent and had previously reported incidents of bullying at school.

results.title: GPL 2026/27: Kotoko chase return to winning ways against Medeama
results.content: The Porcupine Warriors head into the high-profile fixture under pressure to improve their league position after settling for a 1-1 draw against FC Ashanti Gold '04 at the Len Clay Stadium last Sunday.

results.title: Multimedia Group partners with Influencer Africa to bring top content creators to radio and television
results.content: The Multimedia Group Limited (MGL), in partnership with Influencer Africa, has brought together some of Ghana's prominent social media influencers, content creators and entertainment personalities to feature on selected programmes across its radio and television platforms.

results.title: Ghana Medical Trust Fund courts US partners to expand cancer care
results.content: The Ghana Medical Trust Fund (GMTF) is seeking partnerships with American hospitals, investors and philanthropists to expand cancer treatment and other specialist healthcare services in Ghana.

results.title: Ghanival 2026 to bring Brazilian carnival experience to Accra on December 12
results.content: Ghana is set to host a new cultural and entertainment event, Ghanival 2026, which will combine elements of Brazilian carnival with Ghanaian music, culture, fashion, food and dance. results.title: A call for support and solidarity with ministers from Volta Region amid incessant attacks by NPP
results.content: The incessant attacks on Ministers from the Volta Region by the New Patriotic Party (NPP) and sections of the media perceived as sympathetic to it are increasingly worrying.

results.title: Human rights lawyer couple sentenced to 10 years’ prison in Pakistan
results.content: A Pakistani anti-terrorism court has sentenced human rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband Hadi Ali Chattha to 10 years in prison, over an alleged security breach during a cricket tour in 2024.

results.title: Absa introduces instant loans for eligible salaried customers
results.content: Absa Bank Ghana is expanding access to personal loans with its Instant Loans solution, allowing eligible salaried customers to borrow up to GH¢350,000 through the Bank’s digital banking platforms.

results.title: Rising utility bills wiping out workers’ pay gains – Minority
results.content: The Minority in Parliament says rising electricity and water bills are wiping out public sector workers’ salary gains. It is demanding an immediate review of the 2027 and 2028 pay agreement.

results.title: Two Ghanaians, Kofi Boat and Pascal, face up to 20 years in prison over $100m romance fraud scheme
results.content: Two Ghanaian nationals have pleaded guilty to their roles in an international cybercrime syndicate that defrauded victims across the United States of more than $100 million through romance scams and business email compromise schemes.

results.title: Crypto giant Binance hit by $6.3bn hack suspected to be largest in history
results.content: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that $6.3bn (£4.7bn) in digital assets were affected by what is believed to be the biggest crypto hack on record.

results.title: WPL 2026/27: Oak Ladies host Samartex as Fosu Royal Ladies travel to Prisons Ladies
results.content: Ampem Darkoa Ladies will once again be missing in action following their qualification for the 2026 CAF Women's Champions League after beating Edo Queens.
